data.name: Kenan
data.gender_notes: Kenan is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Kenan is recorded in name-lists as “Jehovah's gift”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kenan expresses “Jehovah's gift”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kenan total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

in_hebrew.name: כֵּעְנָן
in_hebrew.meaning: שֵם שֶׁמַּעֲדֶה לְאִישׁ, שֵם שֶׁיִּתְלוֹאֵס בַּעֲבָדִים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: כֵּעְנָן הוא שֵם שֶׁמַּעֲדֶה לְאִישׁ, כאשר כֵּעְנָן בְּשֵם חָכָם, וְזֶה יצא מִשֵּם גֵּא

in_greek.name: Κέναν
in_greek.meaning: ὄνομα ἀνδρὸς, ὄνομα ὃ μορφοῦται ἀπὸ σλαβική
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὁ Κέναν ἐστὶν ὄνομα ἀνδρὸς, ἡ ἀπὸ σλαβικῆς γλώσσης ἀπευθυνόμενη ὑπὸ τῶν Ἑλλήνων, ἀπὸ τῆς Ἑβραϊκῆς ἔμψυχης ὀνοματοδοσίας, τῆς ὁποίας σήμανε τοὺς κατέχοντας ἐξουσίας

in_latin.name: Kenan
in_latin.long_meaning: Kenan est nomen viri, radix significativa servitutis, ex Hebraico oriens, in Ecclesia Christiana usus, et in historiae culturae tractatus
